title: Analysis: Palo Alto Networks shareholders have voted to reject pay packages for top executives seven times since 2015, more than any other S&P 500 company (Andrew Martin/Bloomberg)
summary: Andrew Martin / Bloomberg: Analysis: Palo Alto Networks shareholders have voted to reject pay packages for top executives seven times since 2015, more than any other S&P 500 company — A majority of Palo Alto Networks investors have voted against the cybersecurity company's executive pay seven times in 11 years.
